title: Keep a person able to review
summary: An AI result should be easy to question and correct. For important choices, people need the evidence, limits and a way to reject a poor suggestion.
introduction: An AI result should be easy to question and correct. For important choices, people need the evidence, limits and a way to reject a poor suggestion. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain keep a person able to review
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An AI result should be easy to question and correct. For important choices, people need the evidence, limits and a way to reject a poor suggestion.

blocks.code:
Suggestion: choose route B
Evidence: route A has a closed gate
Limit: map was checked yesterday
Review: confirm the gate and path are still safe
blocks.title: Keep a person able to review

blocks.text: The explanation lets someone test the reason for the suggestion. If the map is old, the route may need changing.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a way for a user to report an incorrect map detail.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A fluent explanation can still contain false facts; check the evidence.
For more detail later, use this [Artificial Intelligence further reading](https://ai4k12.org/resources/).
